summary: OpenAI published a customer case study describing how Preply uses ChatGPT Enterprise, the API, and Codex to power an AI-generated lesson-feedback feature called Lesson Insights and internal workflows.

practices.reason: The case study describes a customer application (transcript analysis and feedback generation) rather than a stated model update or capability change, so there is nothing new to adopt from this alone.
practices.quote: After each 1:1 lesson, OpenAI analyzes the lesson transcript and generates tailored feedback across grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation.

practices.reason: Describes an existing customer integration pattern (transcript to API-generated report) but is not a change to the API surface itself.
practices.quote: Insight generation is scheduled a few minutes before the end of the session, so feedback is ready for the tutor and student to review together.
